name: Conservation, Food & Health Foundation
program: Concept applications (conservation, agriculture, health sciences) for developing-world projects
collect_note: No call rows can be made: the two concept cycles (online application October 15 to December 22, and May 1 to June 15, each with its proposal and award dates) are published on the How to Apply page without a year, and the collector never invents a year, so no deadline can be dated from plain HTTP. The How to Apply page is watched twice a day; a change to the cycle dates or the call wording is flagged for review, which is the signal to act on. The funder's own RSS feed holds only a 2017 blog post and is not a call source; the grant portal (Foundant GLM, grantinterface.com) is login-gated.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET 2026-11-12 (no cookies, no JS). Home https://cfhfoundation.grantsmanagement08.com/ HTTP 200, 20,411 B, WordPress (no call listing, no year-bearing deadline). How to Apply ?page_id=6 HTTP 200, 2,147 chars: Cycle 1 online application opens October 15th, concept deadline December 22nd, invitation January 15th, full proposal February 15th, awards July 1st; Cycle 2 opens May 1st, concept deadline June 15th, invitation July 15th, proposal August 15th, awards December 1st (no year on any date). FAQ ?page_id=7 HTTP 200 repeats the same cycles, no year. Feeds ?feed=rss2, ?feed=rss, ?feed=atom, ?feed=comments-rss2, ?cat=1&feed=rss2 all HTTP 200 with a single 2017 blog post (lastBuildDate 2021-11-23): rejected. WordPress REST index.php?rest_route=/wp/v2/types returns core types only; /wp/v2/pages returns 6 pages; /wp/v2/posts returns one 2017 post; no custom opportunity post type. sitemap.xml, wp-sitemap.xml, sitemap_index.xml, robots.txt: HTTP 404. No ld+json, no __NEXT_DATA__, no Algolia, Airtable, Google Sheets or ics embed on the pages. Grant portal https://www.grantinterface.com/Home/Logon?urlkey=gma HTTP 200 (Foundant GLM login page; the public index is vendor marketing; no public call list; the access code printed on the funder's FAQ was not entered). Preview PDF CFH-Concept-Application-Preview.pdf HTTP 200 (question form, no dated call). Grants.gov and SEDIA: not applicable (private US foundation, no federal pass-through, no EU topic). endpoint_recon.py run with --no-chrome (port 9333 down): verdict rss, confidence 0.9, the feed is the stale blog post. Self replay (scratch, labeled 'Concept application deadline' with a regex capture) returned 0 items: the year-less dates cannot be parsed. Re-checked 2026-11-12: page_id 4/6/7/8/10/271 text has no year-bearing cycle date (only a template footer 'January 01 2026 12:00 pm' unrelated to any call); WP REST pages list shows modified stamps only; PDF CFH-LOI-Questions.pdf is a 2023 question form; web search finds only third-party listings, no official dated 2026 or 2027 call. extract.ts date patterns all require a 4-digit year, so self/deadline_regex on 'December 22nd' yields no item.
page_reason: Concept cycles are published only as month-day text with no year and no call list, so the collector cannot create a dated call row. Page watch on the How to Apply page is the best available monitor until the foundation publishes a year (for example Cycle 1 2027 December 22, 2027) or a call list; if that appears, switch to mode self with a deadline_regex capturing the full date.
